description: Write plain scope language for one to three fixed packages: an included line for each deliverable, an adjustments line (adjustments to anything delivered are included at no added cost), out-of-scope lines (deliverables from larger packages and anything listed as excluded), the rule that a genuinely new deliverable becomes a new package scoped and priced before work starts, worked boundary examples, and a ready-to-paste text block per package. Lines that use time-based or extra-charge wording are left out and named in notes. Written in "we" by default or "I" for a solo business.

ascending.description: True when packages are listed smallest first and each includes the one before it. Default true when there is more than one package.

excludes.description: Things clients often assume are included but are not, for example "Printing" or "Permit fees".

includes.description: Deliverables with quantities where they matter, for example "2 logo concepts" or "One site visit and measurements".

voice.description: "we" (default) for a team, "I" for a solo business.

name: package_scope_language
title: Write package scope language
